title: The Exodus
summary: Fürth, February 2771. The Crown's commissary rides with Rome's verdict. Meister Hollweg does not wait for him: by night the guild leaves the Crown, with its families, down the frozen road to the Main.

sides.name: The Exodus
sides.about: Meister Hollweg's guild and its families, leaving Fürth by night.

sides.name: The Commissary
sides.about: The Crown's commissary with Rome's verdict, Colonel von Rauch's riders and guns, and Father Ferrer as Rome's witness.

objectives.text: Fürth fell to the machine: its seed stands in the guild's own works. Burn it before the families can leave.
Load the family carts: {loaded} of {carts_n}. Move any of your men to a cart at its barn and keep him there a moment: the family climbs in.
objectives.phone: Load the family carts: {loaded} of {carts_n}. A man at each cart's barn a moment.

objectives.text: Load the drawings: bring Meister Hollweg to his own barn, west of the yard. Only he knows which chests.
Jakob is waiting by the yard. Bring Meister Hollweg to him: he has something to say.
The commissary's riders come in {clock:riders}. Whatever is not loaded by then stays behind.
Get the carts down the valley to the barges on the Main: {families_out} of {carts_n} families out. Keep fighters by every cart: riders who stand round a cart with none of yours by it TAKE it.
objectives.phone: Carts to the barges: {families_out} of {carts_n} out. Keep fighters by every cart.

objectives.text: Meister Hollweg must live. Hurt, he falls back to the carts.
Hold the brook bridge until the last barge is loaded: {clock:last_barge}.
Build the Ratchet Turret at the bridge's foot: send a Winder to its site.
The last barge is loaded. Get Meister Hollweg aboard: walk him onto the jetty.
After them: over the Rednitz bridge and down the valley. The guild's only road to the Main runs through it.
Take the carts: {carts_taken} taken. Stand men round a cart with none of the guild's fighters by it. Rome's order is to take, not to kill.
Take Meister Hollweg alive before the last barge: bring him down and stand a man by him.

deny.why: The works are being left: nothing more is built or made in Fürth.

k_open1.text: Ten months after Rome I signed the commissary's orders myself. Seize the works at Fürth. Stop every machine that winds itself.

k_open2.text: Hollweg was told the commissary was coming. He did not wait for him.

h_open1.text: I called it a rescue. The families had nowhere else. The machines had nowhere at all.

h_open2.text: We rang the night bell at the barn. By morning Fürth was empty.

k_open_c.text: Father Ferrer rode with the commissary as Rome's witness. He wrote down what he saw. He always did.

f_open_c.text: We were a day's ride off when the dogs found their scent. The guild was already on the road.

h_1.text: Every family to its cart. Every machine that can walk, wind it. We leave tonight.

u_tip1.text: The carts wait at the barns, Meister. Send one of ours to each and the family climbs in. The marked ones on the map.

u_tip2.text: Your spring cart winds anything that stands on the brass plates round it. Keep the soldiers near it on the road and they never run down.

u_tip_new.text: The Clock Soldiers know the shield wall now, Meister. Raise their shields with SHIELD FORWARD on their card when the muskets face them.

n_loaded.text: A family climbs into its cart.

h_draw0.text: And the drawings. Every sheet of the Perpetual. Nobody touches those chests but me.

h_draw.text: The drawings are aboard. If they take that cart, they take everything I ever made.

h_people.text: No drawings this time. I left them in Nuremberg for the people. I carry the Perpetual in my head.

j_wait.text: Meister. Before you go. Come here, please.

j_stay1.text: I am not coming, Meister. I told Father Ferrer what I found, and I will tell the commissary.

h_stay.text: They will melt everything, Jakob. Everything we built.

j_stay2.text: Then let them. I would rather melt a wheel than see it take out its own stop-work again. God keep you, Meister.

n_jakob_goes.text: Jakob walks up the street to the Crown's camp, and does not look back.

h_nojakob.text: Jakob would have known which wheels to leave. Jakob is not here.

u_warn.text: Riders on the Bamberg road, Meister. Not long now.

n_left.text: The carts nobody loaded stay at their barns. Those families stay in Fürth.

h_fallen.text: The machine sits in my own works. My own tower. Burn its seed, or no cart leaves this yard.

h_reclaimed.text: It is down. Now the families. Quickly.

u_dogs.text: Dogs, Meister! They are early! The carts must go now!

h_road.text: West over the Rednitz, then down the valley to the Main. Keep a fighter by every cart.

u_take.text: They will not shoot the carts, Meister. They will stand round one until it is theirs. Drive them off it and the bar empties.

u_riders.text: Riders in the valley! They came round by the Würzburg track, from the north!

u_dogs2.text: Dogs on the slope, Meister, and riders behind them! They have our scent!

u_column.text: The commissary's column is in the yard behind us. Musketeers, and guns.

u_column_m.text: The commissary's column is in the yard behind us. Musketeers, and more nets than guns.

n_sortie.text: In the empty works, red lights. The machine has come out of Nuremberg for what we left.

h_sortie.text: Let it have the walls. It will meet the commissary before it meets us.

n_taken.text: A cart is taken. Its family goes back to Fürth under the Crown's guard.

u_retake.text: Get round that cart before it reaches their camp and it is ours again!

n_retaken.text: The cart is the guild's again, and turns back for the Main.

h_draw_taken.text: The drawings! They have the drawings!

r_minute.text: Halt. All of you. Let them go, God help them. One minute.

b_minute.text: Colonel! You have the Crown's orders!

h_minute.text: Von Rauch remembered the bells of Nuremberg. Go, now, while he looks away!

r_minute_end.text: The minute is up. After them.

n_landing.text: The Main at last: the barges at the jetty, the bargemen stamping their feet in the snow.

u_clock.text: We set up the travelling clock by the brook, Meister. Its field winds anything near it. Five of the journeymen came over on the first barge: they are yours. There is a turret in the crates.

h_bridge.text: Hold the bridge until the last barge is loaded. The shields in front, the turret behind them.

u_turret.text: Send a Winder to the turret's site at the bridge's foot. It builds it with the guild's last coins.

n_barge.text: A barge pushes off down the Main.

u_broken.text: The rearguard is gone, Meister! They are on the landing: get to the barges before they lay hands on you!

n_quiet.text: The bank is quiet. The bargemen hurry the last crates aboard.

u_last.text: The last barge is loaded, Meister! Come aboard, now!

h_aboard.text: Cast off. Do not look back. There is nothing behind us now but the Crown.

n_cast_off.text: The bargemen could wait no longer. The last barge left without the Meister.

n_all_taken.text: Every cart was taken on the road. There was nothing left to save.

h_hurt.text: I am hit. Keep them off me, they want me alive.

n_captured.text: The commissary's men close round Meister Hollweg. He is taken alive.

b_c1.text: By the Council of Rome and the King's seal: the works at Fürth are the Crown's. Ride.

f_c1.text: Take the carts, Commissary. Do not harm the families. And I want Hollweg alive, to answer.

r_c_tip.text: My riders take a cart by standing round it with none of theirs by it. Bring Hollweg down and stand a man by him: he is taken.

f_c_road.text: They are on the road west. The barges on the Main will not wait for us.

r_c_sortie.text: The machine is in the works behind us. Watch the rear.

r_c_push.text: The reserve is on the track, Commissary. Three more muskets and a rider.

f_c_won.text: He is taken. God forgive us both, Meister.

f_c_lost.text: The last barge is gone down the Main. He is beyond the Crown now.

m_1.text: Tick. Tock. The works are empty.

h_end1.text: We went down the Main to the sea, and at Hamburg we took ship. Nobody there asked what was in the crates.

h_end_many.text: Nearly every family came with us. I counted them on the deck, every morning.

h_end_some.text: Some of the families came. The others went back to Fürth in the Crown's carts.

h_end_few.text: Few of the families came. The deck was very quiet.

h_end_draw.text: And the drawings came with me. Every sheet.

h_end_drawlost.text: The drawings stayed with the Crown. I drew them again from memory, on the ship.

h_end_jakob.text: Jakob stayed. I wrote to him from Hamburg. He never answered.

h_end_manifest.text: The ship's manifest said: machinery, for a mine in the southern highlands of Brazil. That was true. It was my mine.

k_end1.text: He calls it a rescue. I call it what it was. The guild left the Crown that night, and took its families with it.

k_end2.text: I do not blame the families. I blame the man who told them the Crown would melt their children's bread.

k_end_c.text: Hollweg in the Crown's custody, twenty-four years before he came to my fire. That is not how it went.

f_end_c.text: We brought him to Rome in irons, and the carts back to Fürth. The commissary called it a success.

new_ratchet_turret.text: NEW: THE RATCHET TURRET. A gun of screws that stands still and fires at ground and air. It must stand linked to a gear field: at the landing a Winder builds one by the travelling clock, the rearguard's last stand.

new_shield_wall.text: NEW: SHIELD WALL. Your Clock Soldiers are drilled to it: press SHIELD FORWARD on their card and they walk slower but take half from shots in front. Raise it facing the muskets.

night_bell.caption: Fürth, February 2771. The night bell: the guild loads its carts.

road.caption: The road down the frozen valley.

rome.caption: Rome, the present. The King listens; the clockmaker tells it.

text: Fürth, February 2771, night. The Crown's commissary is coming with Rome's verdict: seize the works, stop the machines. Meister Hollweg leaves first.
Load the family carts at their barns, then guard them down the valley to the barges on the Main. Riders take any cart with none of your fighters by it.
Meister Hollweg must reach the last barge. The commissary wants him alive.
Fürth, February 2771. You are the Crown's commissary, with Colonel von Rauch's men and Father Ferrer as Rome's witness.
The guild is fleeing for the Main. Take its carts, and take Meister Hollweg alive before the last barge leaves. The machine is behind you.

exodus.title: The Exodus
exodus.text: The guild left Fürth. {families_out} of {carts_n} families reached the barges; {carts_taken} carts were taken on the road.

text_if.text: The drawings were taken by the Crown.

commissary.title: Taken alive
commissary.text: Meister Hollweg is in the Crown's custody. {carts_taken} carts were taken on the road.
